parts.name: frame body

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey, matte-finished C-shaped metal frame forming the backbone of the clamp.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the rigid structural support to resist the clamping force generated by the screw.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the vertical spine or the top/bottom arms of the C-frame to hold the clamp steady.
physics.reason: Small hand tool frames are typically solid cast metal to provide necessary rigidity and strength.

parts.description: Dark grey, matte-finished C-shaped metal frame forming the backbone of the clamp.
parts.function: Provides the rigid structural support to resist the clamping force generated by the screw.

parts.name: anvil pad

physics.Basic_description: Small, light grey circular pad located at the bottom jaw of the frame.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a flat, hard surface for the workpiece to rest against during clamping.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and flush to be a primary grasp target; avoid grasping directly.
physics.reason: Small wear pad is a solid piece of metal attached to the frame.

parts.description: Small, light grey circular pad located at the bottom jaw of the frame.
parts.function: Provides a flat, hard surface for the workpiece to rest against during clamping.

parts.name: screw core

physics.Basic_description: Light grey threaded cylindrical rod running through the center of the frame.
physics.Functional_description: Converts rotational motion from the handle into linear clamping force.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped along the shaft, but threads may damage gripper fingers; prefer handle or frame.
physics.reason: Clamp screws must be solid to withstand high compressive loads without buckling.

parts.description: Light grey threaded cylindrical rod running through the center of the frame.
parts.function: Converts rotational motion from the handle into linear clamping force.

parts.name: screw collar

physics.Basic_description: Light grey ring or collar section on the screw shaft near the handle.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a stop or bearing surface to retain the handle assembly on the screw.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and integrated into the screw assembly to be a useful grasp point.
physics.reason: Integral machined feature or solid ring on the screw shaft.

parts.description: Light grey ring or collar section on the screw shaft near the handle.
parts.function: Acts as a stop or bearing surface to retain the handle assembly on the screw.

parts.name: handle hub

physics.Basic_description: Central light grey block connecting the handle wings to the screw shaft.
physics.Functional_description: Transmits torque from the handle wings to the screw core.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped to rotate the screw, though the wings offer better leverage.
physics.reason: Solid metal component required to transfer torque.

parts.description: Central light grey block connecting the handle wings to the screw shaft.
parts.function: Transmits torque from the handle wings to the screw core.

parts.name: swivel pad

physics.Basic_description: Light grey circular pad at the tip of the screw, facing the anvil.
physics.Functional_description: Swivels to apply even pressure to the workpiece without rotating it.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; it is the active contact point for clamping.
physics.reason: Solid metal pad designed to withstand direct compressive contact.

parts.description: Light grey circular pad at the tip of the screw, facing the anvil.
parts.function: Swivels to apply even pressure to the workpiece without rotating it.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained

simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)
